description:
Sleek and stylish, Encore is a 40-metre Sunseeker designed for guests who appreciate elegance, whether for an exclusive gathering or a private day at sea in Dubai.

Her three decks offer a bright saloon, a formal dining area, a sky lounge and a flybridge with bar and large lounge areas, all looking out over Dubai Marina and Ain Dubai.

She has five cabins, welcomes up to 50 guests and is run by a crew of 10.

Contact Yacht Research for availability, routes and a tailored quote.
